definition_zh: n. 食堂，餐厅（工厂、学校内）；水壶；（成套）餐具箱
definition_en: a dining room in a workplace or school; a small flask for drinking water; a box of cutlery
core_image: 工地架子上挂着的一排水壶，背后是食堂的窗口
scene: 工人拧开水壶喝了一口，然后排队进食堂吃午饭。The men drank from a canteen, then queued for lunch inside.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：canteen 可指食堂，也可指随身水壶；句意是工人先用水壶喝水，再排队进食堂。

senses.title: A workplace dining room
senses.definition: a room where employees or students buy and eat meals
senses.definitionCN: 员工或学生买饭吃饭的房间
senses.example: The canteen serves hot food until two.
senses.exampleCN: 食堂供应热饭到两点。
senses.why: The word came through French from an Italian word for a cellar or wine shop.
senses.whyCN: 这个词经法语来自意大利语「地窖、酒铺」。

senses.title: A small water flask
senses.definition: a small container for drinking water, carried on a belt or in a pack
senses.definitionCN: 挂在腰上或装在包里的饮水容器
senses.example: Fill your canteen before the walk.
senses.exampleCN: 徒步前把水壶灌满。
senses.why: Soldiers carried the flask long before factories built dining rooms, and the same word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 士兵带水壶远早于工厂建食堂，同一个词兼指两者。

intro.en: Canteen comes through French from Italian cantina, a cellar or wine shop.
intro.cn: canteen 经法语源自意大利语 cantina，意为地窖或酒铺。

items.en: Cantina means a cellar or wine shop.
items.cn: cantina 意为地窖或酒铺。

items.en: Cantine means a soldier shop.
items.cn: cantine 意为军营小卖部。

items.en: English canteen names a military store.
items.cn: 十八世纪英语指军中售卖处。

items.en: Canteen also means a soldier water bottle.
items.cn: 十九世纪也指士兵水壶。

items.en: Factories open canteens for workers.
items.cn: 二十世纪工厂为工人设食堂。

items.en: Canteen means a staff dining room.
items.cn: 现代多指员工食堂。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cant- opening; the near-meaning group splits dining rooms from drinking flasks.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cant- 开头；近义组把就餐场所与饮水器具分开。

normalIntro.en: A canteen is a small shop that grew into a lunch room.

normal.en: Cantina was a cellar or shop.

normal.en: Soldiers bought food at a canteen.

normal.en: They carried a water canteen too.
normal.cn: 他们还带一只水壶。

normal.en: Factories later built canteens.
normal.cn: 后来工厂也建食堂。

normal.en: One word, two everyday objects.
normal.cn: 一个词，两样日常物件。

abstract.en: A queue that ends at a hot counter.
abstract.cn: 一条通向热菜柜台的队伍。

abstract.en: Metal against a hip on a long march.
abstract.cn: 长途行军时贴着胯骨的金属。

abstract.en: A room and a bottle that both keep you going.

examples.en: The canteen is closed for repairs this week.
examples.cn: 食堂本周因维修关闭。

examples.en: Workers eat lunch in the canteen at noon.
examples.cn: 工人们中午在食堂吃饭。

sensesIntro.en: The dining room and the flask both exist to keep people fed and watered away from home.
sensesIntro.cn: 食堂与水壶都是为了让人离家在外也有饭吃、有水喝。

latinIntro.en: Italian cantina is a cellar, Latin mensa is a table, and ampulla is a small bottle.

definition_zh: n. 帆布；油画布；（一幅）油画
definition_en: strong heavy cloth used for sails and tents; the cloth a painting is made on, or the painting itself
core_image: 被海风鼓满、绳结发响的一片厚布
scene: 帆布被风鼓满，绳子绷得发响。The canvas filled with wind and the ropes began to hum.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：canvas 指帆布；句意是帆布被风鼓满，绳索发出声响。

collocations.zh: 空白画布；未经雕琢的境地

senses.title: Heavy strong cloth
senses.definition: strong cloth made from hemp or cotton, used for sails, tents and bags
senses.definitionCN: 用大麻或棉制成的厚布，用于帆、帐篷和袋子
senses.example: They slept under canvas for three weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住帐篷住了三周。
senses.why: The word comes from Latin cannabis, hemp, the plant the cloth was woven from.
senses.whyCN: 这个词源自拉丁语 cannabis（大麻），即织布用的植物。

senses.title: The surface for a painting
senses.definition: the cloth a painter works on, or a finished painting on it
senses.definitionCN: 画家作画所用之布，或布上完成的画
senses.example: The gallery owns twelve canvases by her.
senses.exampleCN: 美术馆藏有她的十二幅油画。
senses.why: Painters took over the word for the cloth they stretched on frames.
senses.whyCN: 画家把这个词用来指绷在框上的布。

intro.en: Canvas comes from Latin cannabis, hemp, because the first canvas was woven from hemp.
intro.cn: canvas 源自拉丁语 cannabis（大麻），因为最早的帆布用大麻织成。

items.en: Cannabis means hemp.
items.cn: cannabis 意为大麻。

items.en: English canvas names hemp cloth.
items.cn: 十三世纪英语指大麻布。

items.en: Canvas becomes the standard sail cloth.
items.cn: 十五世纪成为制帆的标准布料。

items.en: Painters stretch canvas on wooden frames.
items.cn: 十六世纪画家把帆布绷在木框上。

items.en: Armies sleep under canvas.
items.cn: 十七世纪军队住帆布帐篷。

items.en: Canvas covers bags, shoes and artworks.
items.cn: 现代指包、鞋与画作。

note.en: The look-alike group is the canvas-canvass trap and its neighbours; the near-meaning group lists strong cloths and the painter surface.
note.cn: 形近组是 canvas 与 canvass 的易混对及邻近词；近义组列出厚织物与作画表面。

entries.definition: To ask people for votes or opinions.
More than one canvas.
The grounds of a school.
Strong cloth used for sails.
Cloth woven from flax.
A heavy waterproof cloth.
A picture painted in oils.

normalIntro.en: Canvas is hemp cloth: the plant name is still hiding inside it.

normal.en: Cannabis meant hemp.

normal.en: Hemp was woven into canvas.

normal.en: Sails and tents were canvas.

abstract.en: Cloth that can take a whole wind.

abstract.en: A surface waiting to be painted.

abstract.en: A sail and a picture sharing one weave.

examples.en: He carried water in a canvas bag.
examples.cn: 他用帆布袋装水。

examples.en: The painting is oil on canvas.
examples.cn: 这幅画是布面油画。

examples.en: We slept under canvas beside the river.
examples.cn: 我们在河边的帐篷里过夜。

root: 拉丁 cannabis（大麻）→ 大麻织成的厚布 → 帆布

sensesIntro.en: The sail and the painting are the same cloth, one catching wind and one holding paint.
sensesIntro.cn: 帆与画是同一种布，一个兜风，一个盛颜料。

core.cn: 核心意象：被风鼓满、绳索作响的厚布

definition_zh: 峡谷；深谷；海底峡谷；城市峡谷
definition_en: a deep narrow valley with steep sides, usually cut by a river; also a similar narrow passage between high walls
core_image: 河水在岩层里切出一条又深又窄的竖缝，两侧是几乎垂直的岩壁
scene: 河水在岩层里切出一条又深又窄的缝，站在边缘看不到底。The canyon drops three hundred metres from rim to river.
sceneCN: 此处指「河流在岩层中切出的深窄峡谷」（第 1 个义项：两壁陡直、深度远大于宽度的谷）；句意为从崖缘到河面，这条峡谷垂直下落三百米。图中可辨识物件：垂直岩壁、谷底河流、崖缘、看不到底的深度。

pos.zh: 峡谷；深谷（两壁陡直）；海底峡谷；城市峡谷

collocations.zh: 城市峡谷（高楼夹出的街道）

senses.title: A deep narrow river-cut valley
senses.definition: a deep valley with steep rock walls, cut by a river over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 由河流长期切割而成、两壁陡直的深谷
senses.example: The canyon drops three hundred metres from rim to river.
senses.exampleCN: 从崖缘到河面，这条峡谷垂直下落三百米。
senses.why: Spanish cañón named a tube or pipe; the word pictures a narrow channel with walls, not a broad valley.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语 cañón 原指管子；这个词勾勒的是一条有壁的窄通道，而不是宽阔的谷。

senses.title: The canyon country as a region
senses.definition: a district characterised by many deep canyons, often used in place names
senses.definitionCN: 以众多深峡谷为特征的地带，常用于地名
senses.example: The canyon country attracts geologists every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这片峡谷地带每年春天都吸引地质学家。
senses.why: One canyon becomes a landscape when many of them define a whole district.
senses.whyCN: 当许多峡谷共同定义一整片地区时，一条峡谷就变成一种地貌景观。

senses.title: A submarine canyon
senses.definition: a steep-sided underwater valley cut into the continental slope
senses.definitionCN: 切入大陆坡的陡壁海底谷
senses.example: Sediment flows down the submarine canyon after storms.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后，沉积物沿海底峡谷向下流动。
senses.why: The same cutting process works under water, so the same word names the submerged form.
senses.whyCN: 同样的切割过程在水下也起作用，同一个词于是指被水淹没的那一版。

senses.title: An urban canyon
senses.definition: a street enclosed by tall buildings on both sides, studied for wind and heat effects
senses.definitionCN: 两侧被高楼夹住的街道，常被研究风与热效应
senses.example: The urban canyon traps heat until well after sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 这条城市峡谷把热量困住，直到日落后很久。
senses.why: Tall walls on both sides reproduce the geometry of a canyon, so city planning borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 两侧高墙复制了峡谷的几何形状，于是城市规划借用了这个词。

senses.title: A narrow deep passage
senses.definition: a narrow gap between high walls, natural or artificial
senses.definitionCN: 高墙之间的狭窄缝隙，天然或人造皆可
senses.example: The trail squeezes through a canyon of broken rock.
senses.exampleCN: 小径从一条碎石夹成的窄缝中挤过去。
senses.why: Width and depth, not a river, are what the word really requires.
senses.whyCN: 这个词真正要求的是宽度与深度，而不是必须有河。

senses.title: A huge gap between positions
senses.definition: a very large separation between opinions, generations or groups
senses.definitionCN: 意见、代际或群体之间的巨大分隔
senses.example: A canyon separates the two sides of the debate.
senses.exampleCN: 一场辩论的两方之间隔着一道鸿沟。
senses.why: A deep gap in the ground becomes a deep gap in agreement: both are measured by distance across.
senses.whyCN: 地面的深缝变成意见上的深缝：两者都用「跨越的距离」来衡量。

senses.title: Attributive: of a canyon
senses.definition: used before a noun for the walls, rim or floor of a canyon
senses.definitionCN: 放在名词前，指峡谷的壁、缘或底
senses.example: Canyon walls record millions of years of rock layers.
senses.exampleCN: 峡谷岩壁记录着数百万年的岩层。
senses.why: The noun simply marks which part or feature of the landform is meant.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词只是标出所指的是地貌的哪个部分或特征。

senses.title: A canyon-like landform type
senses.definition: a class of landform in geology, defined by depth, wall steepness and narrow floor
senses.definitionCN: 地质学中按深度、壁陡度与窄谷底定义的一类地貌
senses.example: The survey mapped every canyon in the basin.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查标出了盆地内每一条峡谷。
senses.why: Science turns the everyday word into a measurable category with thresholds.
senses.whyCN: 科学把这个日常词变成带有阈值的可测量类别。

intro.en: Canyon is an American Spanish loan from cañón 'tube, gorge', built on Latin canna 'reed'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: canyon 借自美洲西班牙语 cañón「管、峡」，后者由拉丁 canna「芦苇」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Latin canna meant 'reed, cane' and, by extension, anything tube-like; it is a borrowing from Greek kanna, itself probably from an Asian source.
items.cn: 拉丁 canna 意为「芦苇、茎」，引申指任何管状物；它借自希腊语 kanna，而后者可能又来自亚洲某语言。

items.en: Spanish caño meant 'tube, pipe, channel'; the augmentative cañón named a large tube or a deep narrow passage.
items.cn: 西班牙语 caño 意为「管、管道、水道」；增大的形式 cañón 指大管子或深窄通道。

items.en: In the southwestern Spanish-speaking world cañón was applied to the deep river-cut valleys of the region, adding the landscape sense.
items.cn: 在西南部讲西班牙语的地区，cañón 被用于当地由河流切出的深谷，从而增添了地貌义。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the nineteenth century, first in accounts of expeditions in the American West.
items.cn: 英语在 19 世纪借入这个词，最早出现在对美国西部考察的记述中。

items.en: The submarine sense is twentieth-century oceanography; the urban sense comes from city climate studies after tall buildings changed street wind patterns.
items.cn: 海底义属于 20 世纪的海洋学；城市义来自高楼改变街道风况之后的城市气候研究。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the Spanish-to-English date is approximate, and the pre-Latin origin of Greek kanna cannot be established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：从西班牙语进入英语的年代为约数，希腊 kanna 在拉丁语之前的来源无法确立。

note.en: The first group holds words that differ from canyon by one or two letters; the second holds words for narrow steep valleys.
note.cn: 第一组是与 canyon 差一两个字母的词；第二组是表示狭窄陡壁谷地的词。

entries.definition: A rule, or an accepted list of texts; it ends in -on, with no y, and comes from Greek kanōn 'rule'.
entries.definitionCN: 规则，或被认可的一组文本；结尾是 -on，没有 y，来自希腊 kanōn「规则」。

entries.definition: A large gun; it has a doubled n and comes through French from Italian cannone 'large tube'.
entries.definitionCN: 大炮；有双写 n，经法语来自意大利 cannone「大管子」。

entries.definition: The plural of canyon; the -s marks number, not a new word.
entries.definitionCN: canyon 的复数；-s 标记数量，不是新词。

entries.definition: A common misspelling that adds an r; it is not an English word.
entries.definitionCN: 常见误拼，多了一个 r；它不是英语词。

entries.definition: A narrow steep valley, often with a river; it is usually narrower than a canyon and less associated with dry country.
entries.definitionCN: 狭窄陡壁的谷，常有河流；通常比峡谷更窄，也不那么常与干旱地区联系。

entries.definition: Low land between high sides; it is broad and gently sloping, while a canyon is narrow with steep walls.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧高地之间的低地；宽阔而坡缓，而峡谷窄且壁陡。

entries.definition: A small deep valley worn by running water; it is much smaller than a canyon and usually has soil slopes.
entries.definitionCN: 由流水冲蚀的小深谷；比峡谷小得多，坡面通常是土。

entries.definition: A deep opening in the earth, often with vertical sides; it stresses the void and the drop rather than a valley floor.
entries.definitionCN: 地面上的深裂口，常为垂直壁；强调空洞与落差，而非谷底。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Spanish route, the real compounds and the modern technical senses.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的西班牙语路径、真实的复合词与现代技术义。

normal.en: Latin canna 'reed' gives Spanish caño 'tube', then cañón 'large tube'.
normal.cn: 拉丁 canna「芦苇」给出西班牙语 caño「管」，再成为 cañón「大管子」。

normal.en: The family runs canyon, canyons, canyon wall, canyon floor, canyon rim.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 canyon、canyons、canyon wall、canyon floor、canyon rim。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: deep canyon, canyon rim, submarine canyon, urban canyon.
normal.cn: 固定搭配有 deep canyon、canyon rim、submarine canyon、urban canyon。

normal.en: A canyon is measured by depth and wall steepness, not by length.
normal.cn: 峡谷用深度与壁陡度衡量，而不是长度。

normal.en: A valley opens; a canyon cuts. The difference is the wall.
normal.cn: 山谷是敞开的，峡谷是切开的；差别就在那面壁。

abstract.en: Picture a knife cutting straight down through many coloured layers of cake.
abstract.cn: 想象一把刀垂直切穿许多层颜色分明的蛋糕。

abstract.en: Picture two glass walls so close that the sky becomes a narrow strip.
abstract.cn: 想象两面玻璃墙靠得很近，天空缩成一条窄缝。

abstract.en: Picture two people on opposite rims who can see each other but cannot reach each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人站在对面的崖缘，能看见彼此却走不到一起。

examples.en: The river has cut the canyon deeper by a few centimetres each century.
examples.cn: 这条河每个世纪都把峡谷再切深几厘米。

examples.en: Hikers must carry water because the canyon floor is much hotter than the rim.
examples.cn: 徒步者必须带水，因为谷底比崖缘热得多。

examples.en: The street forms an urban canyon that blocks the evening breeze.
examples.cn: 这条街形成一条城市峡谷，挡住了傍晚的微风。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「看（kan）+ 甬（yon）」—— 往下看，只见一条像甬道的深窄石缝 → 峡谷

root: 美洲西班牙语 cañón「大管子、深峡」← 西班牙语 caño「管」← 拉丁 canna「芦苇、茎」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all keep one geometry: a narrow slot with steep walls, cut by water, by cities or by disagreement.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都保留同一种几何：一条两壁陡直的窄缝，由水、城市或分歧切出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deep vertical slot cut into layered rock, with two nearly parallel walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：在层状岩层中切出的深竖缝，两侧岩壁几乎平行。

branches.en: THE LANDFORM: the river-cut slot, the district it defines and the geological class.
branches.cn: 地貌：河流切出的窄缝、它定义的地区以及地质类别。

branches.en: UNDER WATER: the same slot forms on the continental slope.
branches.cn: 水下：同样的窄缝在大陆坡上形成。

branches.en: BUILT WALLS: streets and rock passages reproduce the geometry.
branches.cn: 人造的壁：街道与岩缝复制了这种几何。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: a deep gap in ground becomes a deep gap between positions.
branches.cn: 比喻：地面的深缝变成立场之间的深缝。

branches.en: THE PARTS: walls, rim and floor are named by the noun in attributive use.
branches.cn: 各个部分：壁、崖缘与谷底由该名词的定语用法命名。

intro.en: Canyon is a Spanish loan with a clear Latin base; English builds compounds on it rather than suffixes.
intro.cn: canyon 是西班牙语借词，拉丁基础清晰；英语主要在它上面造复合词，而非后缀派生。

latinIntro.en: Latin canna 'reed' underlies Spanish caño and cañón; Latin canalis 'channel' is a related derivative of the same stem, which is why canal appears in the wider family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 canna「芦苇」是西班牙语 caño 与 cañón 的基础；拉丁 canalis「水道」是同词干的相关派生词，这就是 canal 出现在更广词族中的原因。

The submarine canyon feeds a fan of sediment.

definition_zh: 帽子；盖子；上限
definition_en: a soft head covering, or a cover that fits on the top of something
core_image: 一个圆顶的东西扣在头顶或瓶口上
scene: 他走进教室时把头上的帽子摘了下来。He took off his cap as he walked into the classroom.
sceneCN: 这里 cap 是「帽子」（第 1 个义项：有帽檐的软帽）；句意是他走进教室时把帽子摘了下来。

derivatives.zh: cap 加 -ful 构成，义为「一帽之量」
cap 加 -ed 构成，义为「带盖的、有上限的」
un- 加 cap 构成，义为「打开盖子」

senses.title: A soft hat with a peak
senses.definition: a soft hat with a stiff part at the front to shade the eyes
senses.definitionCN: 前部有硬檐、可以遮住眼睛的软帽
senses.example: He wore a blue cap and a light jacket.
senses.exampleCN: 他戴着一顶蓝帽，穿一件薄外套。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a covering for the head, borrowed from Latin cappa, a hood.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是「头上覆盖物」，借自拉丁语 cappa（头巾）。

senses.title: A cover for the top of something
senses.definition: a cover that fits over the top of a bottle, pen, or tube
senses.definitionCN: 盖在瓶子、笔或管子顶端的罩子
senses.example: Put the cap back on the bottle.
senses.exampleCN: 把瓶盖重新盖上。
senses.why: If a cap sits on a head, the same shape sits on a bottle, so the word moved to covers.
senses.whyCN: 既然帽是扣在头上的，同样的形状扣在瓶口上，词义就自然延伸到「盖子」。

senses.title: An upper limit
senses.definition: the highest amount that is allowed or possible
senses.definitionCN: 被允许或可能达到的最高数额
senses.example: The government set a cap on energy prices.
senses.exampleCN: 政府为能源价格设定了上限。
senses.why: A cover marks the top of a container, and a limit marks the top of a range, so cap came to mean ceiling.
senses.whyCN: 盖子是容器的顶端，限额是一个范围的顶端，于是 cap 又引申为「天花板、上限」。

intro.en: Cap began as a word for a hood and slowly moved from heads to bottle tops and to limits.
intro.cn: cap 最初指「头巾」，后来从头上移到瓶口，再引申为「上限」。

items.en: cappa named a hood or a cloak with a hood, probably from a pre-Latin Mediterranean source.
items.cn: cappa 指「头巾、带帽的斗篷」，可能来自拉丁语之前的某地中海语言。

items.en: Old English borrowed it as cæppe, naming a hood or a head covering.
items.cn: 古英语借入为 cæppe，指头巾或头部覆盖物。

items.en: cap settled into everyday use for a close-fitting head covering worn by workers and soldiers.
items.cn: 中古英语里 cap 稳定指工人和士兵戴的贴身帽。

items.en: The sense extended to covers that sit on top of objects, such as the cap of a bottle.
items.cn: 词义扩展到盖在物体顶端的覆盖物，例如瓶盖。

items.en: From the idea of a top piece came the abstract sense of an upper limit, as in a cap on prices.
items.cn: 从「顶端部件」这个想法里长出了抽象义「上限」，例如价格上限。

note.en: Cap shares its root with cape, and its meanings spread from headwear to lids and limits.
note.cn: cap 与 cape 同源，词义从头饰扩展到盖子，再到上限。

entries.definition: a sleeveless cloak, or a point of land
entries.definitionCN: 无袖斗篷，也指海角；与 cap 同出拉丁语 cappa。

entries.definition: having a cap, or limited to a maximum
entries.definitionCN: 带盖的，或设有上限的，由 cap 加 -ed 构成。

entries.definition: the amount that a cap can hold
entries.definitionCN: 一帽之量，由 cap 加 -ful 构成。

entries.definition: a covering for the head, usually with a brim
entries.definitionCN: 帽子，通常带帽檐，是 cap 的上位说法。

entries.definition: a cover that can be lifted off a container
entries.definitionCN: 可以掀开的盖子，对应 cap 的第二个义项。

entries.definition: something placed over an object to protect it
entries.definitionCN: 罩在物体上起保护作用的覆盖物。

entries.definition: the greatest amount that is allowed
entries.definitionCN: 允许的最大数量，对应 cap 的第三个义项。

normalIntro.en: The spelling is short, and the family around it shows each stage of its meaning.
normalIntro.cn: 拼写很短，围绕它的词族正好展示了词义的每一站。

normal.en: cape and cap are cousins, both from Latin cappa, a hooded cloak.
normal.cn: cape 与 cap 是表亲，都来自拉丁语 cappa（带帽斗篷）。

normal.en: baseball cap fixes the first sense in a familiar compound.
normal.cn: baseball cap 这个常见复合词固定了「帽子」这一义项。

normal.en: bottle cap shows the same shape moved from head to bottle.
normal.cn: bottle cap 展示了同一个形状从头顶移到瓶口。

normal.en: cap the price uses the verb, meaning to place a ceiling on something.
normal.cn: cap the price 用动词形式，表示给某物设一个天花板。

normal.en: capful measures by the cap itself, a common pattern with -ful.
normal.cn: capful 用量具本身来计量，是 -ful 的常见构词方式。

abstract.en: Picture a round lid dropping onto a bottle and stopping it.
abstract.cn: 想象一个圆盖落下来，把瓶口封住。

abstract.en: Picture a bar chart with a flat board laid across the top of the bars.
abstract.cn: 想象一张柱状图，顶端被一块平板压住。

abstract.en: Picture a cap shading a pair of eyes on a bright day.
abstract.cn: 想象大太阳下，帽檐替一双眼睛挡住光。

examples.en: He took off his cap as he walked into the classroom.
examples.cn: 他走进教室时把帽子摘了下来。

examples.en: Put the cap back on the bottle.
examples.cn: 把瓶盖重新盖上。

examples.en: The company capped travel spending at a fixed sum.
examples.cn: 公司把差旅支出限定在一个固定数额。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开普」——帽子一扣，头顶就被盖住了。

root: 拉丁语 cappa（头巾、带帽斗篷）→ 古英语 cæppe → cap；同源词有 cape、cappuccio 等。

sensesIntro.en: One shape, three places: on a head, on a bottle, and on the top of a range of numbers.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个形状用在三处：头上、瓶口上，以及一串数字的顶端。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round cover dropped onto the top of something.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个圆形的覆盖物扣在某物的顶端。

branches.en: The clothing sense: a soft hat that shades the eyes.
branches.cn: 衣物义：遮挡眼睛的软帽。

branches.en: The container sense: a small lid on a bottle or pen.
branches.cn: 容器义：瓶口或笔端的小盖子。

branches.en: The abstract sense: a highest allowed amount.
branches.cn: 抽象义：被允许的最高数额。

branches.en: Both the lid and the limit sit on top and stop something from going further.
branches.cn: 盖子和上限都位于顶端，都阻止某物继续外溢或上升。

branches.en: As a verb, cap means to put that ceiling in place.
branches.cn: 作动词时，cap 指把这个天花板设好。

intro.en: Cap is a short base noun that also works as a verb; its family grows with -ed, -ful, and un-.
intro.cn: cap 是简短的基础名词，也可作动词；词族靠 -ed、-ful 和 un- 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin cappa, a hooded cloak, is the source of cap and of several words for head coverings.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cappa（带帽斗篷）是 cap 以及多个「头饰」词的来源。

items.meaning: a soft hat or a cover for a top
items.example: His cap hung on the back of the door.

items.meaning: more than one cap, or he caps something
items.meaningCN: 帽子的复数，或动词第三人称单数

items.meaning: covered with a cap, or limited to a maximum
items.meaningCN: 盖上盖子的，或设有上限的
items.example: The budget was capped at ten thousand dollars.
items.exampleCN: 预算被限制在一万美元以内。

items.meaning: the act of putting a cap or limit on something
items.meaningCN: 加盖或设定上限的动作
items.example: They are capping the well to stop the leak.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在封住井口以阻止泄漏。

items.meaning: as much as a cap holds

items.example: Uncap the pen before you write.
She wrapped a red cape around her shoulders.
items.exampleCN: 她把一件红斗篷披在肩上。

items.meaning: a hood or a hooded cloak
items.example: Cappa passed into several European languages.
items.exampleCN: cappa 进入了多种欧洲语言。

definition_zh: 有能力的；能干的；能够…的
definition_en: having the ability or skill needed to do something
core_image: 一个人挽起袖子，双手稳稳接住递过来的任务
scene: 她一个人就能把这项工作做完。She is capable of finishing the work on her own.
sceneCN: 这里 capable 是「有能力的」（第 1 个义项：具备做成某事的能力）；句意是她有能力独自完成这项工作。

derivatives.zh: capable 加 -ity 构成，义为「能力；性能」
capable 加 -ly 构成，义为「能干地」
in- 加 capable 构成，义为「无能力的」

senses.title: Having the skill to do something
senses.definition: able to do something well because of skill or experience
senses.definitionCN: 因具备技能或经验而能把事情做好
senses.example: She is a capable manager who solves problems quickly.
senses.exampleCN: 她是一位能干的经理，解决问题很快。
senses.why: Latin capere means to take or hold, so capable describes someone who can take a task in hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 capere 意为「抓住、握住」，所以 capable 描写的是能把任务稳稳接在手里的人。

senses.title: Able to do or experience something
senses.definition: having the qualities or conditions needed for something to happen
senses.definitionCN: 具备让某事发生所需要的性质或条件
senses.example: The material is capable of holding a great deal of heat.
senses.exampleCN: 这种材料能够储存大量热量。
senses.why: The idea of holding widens from people to things, so capable of can describe what an object can do.
senses.whyCN: 「容纳、握住」的想法从人扩展到物，所以 capable of 也能说明一个物体能做到什么。

intro.en: Capable comes from a Latin verb for taking hold, and its history explains why it pairs with of.
intro.cn: capable 来自拉丁语中表示「抓住」的动词，这段历史也解释了它为什么常与 of 搭配。

items.en: capere meant to take, to seize, or to hold, and it supplies the root cap-.
items.cn: capere 意为「拿、抓、容纳」，提供了 cap- 这个词根。

items.en: capabilis was formed to mean able to hold or able to receive.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语造出 capabilis，意为「能容纳的、能接受的」。

items.en: The adjective passed into Old French as capable with the same sense of being fit to receive.
items.cn: 这个形容词以 capable 进入古法语，仍表示「能够接受、容纳」。

items.en: English borrowed it to describe a person or thing able to take in or undertake something.
items.cn: 英语借入后，用它描写能够接纳或承担某事的人或物。

items.en: The modern sense focuses on skill and ability, and the pattern be capable of became fixed.
items.cn: 现代义集中在技能与能力上，be capable of 的搭配也固定下来。

note.en: Capable sits in a large Latin family built on capere, and it is close in meaning to able and competent.
note.cn: capable 处在以 capere 为基础的大词族里，语义上又接近 able 与 competent。

entries.definition: the power or skill to do something
entries.definitionCN: 做成某事的能力或性能，由 capable 加 -ity 构成。

entries.definition: in a competent and effective way
entries.definitionCN: 能干地、有效地，由 capable 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: not able to do something
entries.definitionCN: 无能力的，由否定前缀 in- 加 capable 构成。

entries.definition: having the power or skill to do something
entries.definitionCN: 有能力或技能做某事的，最常用的近义词。

entries.definition: having enough skill to do something properly
entries.definitionCN: 具备足够技能、能把事情做合格的。

entries.definition: having trained ability in a particular activity
entries.definitionCN: 在某一活动上受过训练、技术熟练的。

normalIntro.en: The root cap- means to take hold, so capable pictures someone who can take a task in hand.
normalIntro.cn: 词根 cap- 意为「抓住」，所以 capable 的画面是一个人能把任务接在手里。

normal.en: cap- comes from Latin capere, to take or hold.
normal.cn: cap- 来自拉丁语 capere，意为「拿、握住」。

normal.en: The suffix -able adds the sense of being able to do that holding.
normal.cn: 后缀 -able 补上「能够做到」的意思。

normal.en: capability is the noun beside it, and capability and capable share the same stem.
normal.cn: 名词 capability 就在旁边，它与 capable 共用同一个词干。

normal.en: The fixed pattern is be capable of doing, with a gerund rather than a bare verb.
normal.cn: 固定句型是 be capable of doing，后面接动名词而不是动词原形。

normal.en: The opposite is incapable, built with the negative prefix in-.
normal.cn: 反义词是 incapable，用否定前缀 in- 构成。

abstract.en: Picture a pair of hands opening to receive a heavy box and holding it steady.
abstract.cn: 想象一双手张开接住一个重箱子，并稳稳托住。

abstract.en: Picture a tool that fits the hand so well that the work almost does itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一件工具与手贴合得极好，活儿几乎自己就完成了。

abstract.en: Picture a door marked capable that opens when a task is pushed against it.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇写着 capable 的门，任务一推就开。

examples.en: She is capable of finishing the work on her own.
examples.cn: 她有能力独自完成这项工作。

examples.en: He is a capable manager who solves problems quickly.
examples.cn: 他是一位能干的经理，解决问题很快。

examples.en: This material is capable of holding a great deal of heat.
examples.cn: 这种材料能够储存大量热量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开牌」——手里的牌一摊开，什么任务都接得住。

root: 拉丁语 capere（抓住、容纳）+ -abilis（能…的）→ 晚期拉丁语 capabilis → 古法语 capable。

sensesIntro.en: One root meaning to hold branches into personal skill and into what a thing can do.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个表示「容纳、握住」的词根，分叉出人的技能和物的性能两条义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands taking hold of a task and holding it without dropping it.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手接住一项任务，并且稳稳托住不掉。

branches.en: The personal sense: a person with the skill to handle work.
branches.cn: 指人的义项：具备处理工作技能的人。

branches.en: The extended sense: a thing with the properties needed for an effect.
branches.cn: 扩展义：具备产生某种效果所需性质的物。

branches.en: Both senses keep the original image of holding something within reach.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留着「把东西握在可及之处」的原始画面。

branches.en: In appraisal, capable is a solid compliment without the force of brilliant.
branches.cn: 在评价里，capable 是稳妥的褒义，没有 brilliant 那么强烈。

branches.en: Technical writing uses capable of to state what a material or system can do.
branches.cn: 技术写作常用 capable of 说明材料或系统能做什么。

intro.en: Capable is an adjective built from the root cap- plus the suffix -able.
intro.cn: capable 是由词根 cap- 加后缀 -able 构成的形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin capere, to take or hold, is one of the most productive roots in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 capere（拿、握住）是英语中构词能力最强的词根之一。

items.meaning: able to do or hold something

items.exampleCN: 这个包大到能装下一台笔记本电脑。

items.meaning: to take something that is offered

The story captivated the whole class.
items.exampleCN: 这个故事让全班听得入迷。

definition_zh: 容量；能力；产能
definition_en: the amount that something can hold, or the ability to do something
core_image: 一个容器被慢慢灌满，液面升到边缘
scene: 这个水箱能装下一百升水。The tank has a capacity of one hundred litres.
sceneCN: 这里 capacity 是「容量」（第 1 个义项：容器能装下的量）；句意是这个水箱能装一百升水。

derivatives.zh: 与 capacity 同根，义为「容量大的、宽敞的」
in- 加 capacity 构成，义为「无能力；丧失能力」
由同一词根构成，义为「电容器」，即储存电荷的元件

senses.title: The amount a container can hold
senses.definition: the maximum amount that a container, room, or vehicle can hold
senses.definitionCN: 容器、空间或交通工具最多能装下的量
senses.example: The hall has a seating capacity of five hundred.
senses.exampleCN: 这个大厅能容纳五百人就座。
senses.why: Latin capax meant able to hold, so the noun first named how much could be held.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 capax 意为「能容纳的」，所以这个名词最初指「能装多少」。

senses.title: The ability to do or understand something
senses.definition: the mental or physical power to do, learn, or understand something
senses.definitionCN: 做事、学习或理解某事的脑力或体力
senses.example: Children have a remarkable capacity for learning languages.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们学习语言的能力惊人。
senses.why: If the mind is a container, what it can take in is also its capacity.
senses.whyCN: 如果把头脑看成一个容器，它能装进去的东西，自然也被称为 capacity。

senses.title: The maximum amount a factory can produce
senses.definition: the largest amount that a factory, machine, or system can produce in a period
senses.definitionCN: 工厂、机器或系统在一段时间内能产出的最大数量
senses.example: The plant is working at full capacity this month.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂本月正满负荷生产。
senses.why: A production line is treated as a container too: capacity is how much output it can hold.

intro.en: Capacity is the noun of holding: it comes from the Latin adjective for roomy.
intro.cn: capacity 是「容纳」的名词形式，来自拉丁语中表示「能装」的形容词。

items.en: capax meant able to hold or roomy, built on capere, to take or hold.
items.cn: capax 意为「能容纳的、宽敞的」，建立在 capere（拿、容纳）之上。

items.en: capacitas turned that adjective into a noun naming the power to hold.
items.cn: capacitas 把这个形容词变成名词，指「容纳的能力」。

items.en: The noun entered Old French as capacité, keeping the sense of room and ability.
items.cn: 这个名词以 capacité 进入古法语，保留「空间」与「能力」两重意思。

items.en: English borrowed it for the volume a vessel could contain.
items.cn: 英语借入它，用来指容器可容纳的体积。

items.en: The sense widened to mental ability and then to industrial output.
items.cn: 词义先扩展到心智能力，再扩展到工业产出。

note.en: Capacity shares the root capere with capable, and it sits beside other measures of size and power.
note.cn: capacity 与 capable 共享词根 capere，同时和别的「大小、能力」度量词相邻。

entries.definition: having a lot of space inside
entries.definitionCN: 内部空间很大的，与 capacity 同根。

entries.definition: a device that stores electric charge
entries.definitionCN: 电容器，储存电荷的元件，词根同样表示「容纳」。

entries.definition: having the ability to do something
entries.definitionCN: 有能力的，与 capacity 共享 capere 词根。

entries.definition: the amount of space that something occupies
entries.definitionCN: 物体所占空间的量，最接近「容积」的义项。

entries.definition: the power or skill to do something
entries.definitionCN: 做事的能力或技能，对应第二个义项。

entries.definition: the power or skill to do something
entries.definitionCN: 能力、性能，与 capacity 在「能力」义上接近。

entries.definition: the amount that is produced
entries.definitionCN: 产出的数量，对应「产能」这一义项。

normalIntro.en: The root cap- means to hold, and -ity makes it a noun: the holding power of a container.
normalIntro.cn: 词根 cap- 意为「容纳」，-ity 把它变成名词：容器的「容纳力」。

normal.en: cap- comes from Latin capere, to take or hold.
normal.cn: cap- 来自拉丁语 capere，意为「拿、容纳」。

normal.en: -ity turns the adjective into a noun, as in able and ability.
normal.cn: -ity 把形容词变成名词，就像 able 与 ability 的关系。

normal.en: capable and capacity are close relatives with the same stem.
normal.cn: capable 与 capacity 是同一个词干下的近亲。

normal.en: at full capacity is the fixed phrase for a place or machine working to its limit.
normal.cn: at full capacity 是固定说法，指场所或机器满负荷运转。

normal.en: The plural capacities simply changes y to ies.
normal.cn: 复数 capacities 只是把 y 变成 ies。

abstract.en: Picture a glass filled to the very edge, with one more drop ready to spill.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子被灌到杯沿，再一滴就要溢出。

abstract.en: Picture a head with shelves inside, each shelf waiting to be filled with knowledge.
abstract.cn: 想象头脑里有一层层架子，等着被知识填满。

abstract.en: Picture a factory running all night, every machine busy at once.
abstract.cn: 想象工厂通宵运转，每台机器同时开足。

examples.en: The tank has a capacity of one hundred litres.
examples.cn: 这个水箱能装一百升水。

examples.en: The hall has a seating capacity of five hundred.
examples.cn: 这个大厅能容纳五百人就座。

examples.en: The plant is working at full capacity this month.
examples.cn: 这家工厂本月正满负荷生产。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「可拍 city」——一座城能装下多少人，就是它的容量。

root: 拉丁语 capax（能容纳的）→ capacitas（容量）→ 古法语 capacité → 英语 capacity；词根 capere（抓住、容纳）。

sensesIntro.en: Container, mind, and factory are all treated as things with a limit to what they can hold.
sensesIntro.cn: 容器、头脑和工厂都被看成有「容纳上限」的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vessel filled slowly until the surface reaches the rim.
core.cn: 核心意象：容器被慢慢灌满，液面升到边缘。

branches.en: The physical sense: how much a tank, hall, or bus can contain.
branches.cn: 物理义：水箱、大厅或公交车能装多少。

branches.en: The mental sense: how much a person can learn or understand.
branches.cn: 心智义：一个人能学习或理解多少。

branches.en: The industrial sense: how much a plant can produce in a period.
branches.cn: 工业义：工厂在一段时间内能生产多少。

branches.en: All three senses measure a limit of holding, whether space, mind, or machine.
branches.cn: 三个义项都在度量「容纳的上限」，只是对象分别是空间、头脑和机器。

branches.en: at full capacity marks the exact point where no more can be added.
branches.cn: at full capacity 标记的正是再也装不下的那个点。

intro.en: Capacity is a noun built from the root cap- plus the noun suffix -ity.
intro.cn: capacity 是由词根 cap- 加名词后缀 -ity 构成的。

latinIntro.en: Latin capax and capacitas carry the idea of holding, from the verb capere.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 capax 与 capacitas 都承载「容纳」之意，源头是动词 capere。

items.meaning: the amount that can be held
items.example: The battery has a large capacity.
The two plants have similar capacities.
items.exampleCN: 这两家工厂的产能相近。

items.example: A capacious coat has deep pockets.
items.exampleCN: 宽大的外套有很深的口袋。

items.meaning: the state of being unable to do something
items.example: The injury caused a temporary incapacity.
items.exampleCN: 这次受伤造成了暂时的失能。

items.meaning: a device that stores electric charge
items.meaningCN: 电容器，储存电荷的元件
items.example: The capacitor stores energy for the flash.
items.exampleCN: 电容器为闪光灯储存能量。

items.meaning: the ability of a system to store charge
items.meaningCN: 电容，系统储存电荷的能力

items.meaning: having the ability to do something
items.example: She is capable of leading the team.
items.exampleCN: 她有能力带领这个团队。

items.meaning: to take, to hold, to contain
items.example: Capere underlies many words about holding.
items.exampleCN: capere 是许多表示「容纳」的词的底层词根。

definition_zh: n. 披肩，斗篷；海角，岬
definition_en: a sleeveless cloak; a piece of land that sticks out into the sea
core_image: 一个人把斗篷拉紧，站在伸进海里的岩石尽头
scene: 风太大，他把斗篷拉到肩上，站在岬角看浪。He pulled the cape over his shoulders and watched from the headland.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：cape 指斗篷；句意是他把斗篷拉上肩，站在岬角看浪。

senses.title: A sleeveless cloak
senses.definition: a loose piece of clothing worn over the shoulders and hanging loose
senses.definitionCN: 披在肩上、下垂宽松的衣物
senses.example: The actor wore a black cape on stage.
senses.exampleCN: 演员在台上披着黑斗篷。
senses.why: This sense comes from Latin capputium, a hooded garment.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项源自拉丁语 capputium，意为带兜帽的外衣。

senses.title: A point of land
senses.definition: a piece of land that projects into the sea
senses.definitionCN: 伸入海中的陆地
senses.example: The ship rounded the cape at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 船在黎明时绕过海角。
senses.why: This sense comes from Latin caput, head, the head of the land.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项源自拉丁语 caput（头），即陆地之头。

intro.en: Cape has two Latin sources that fell into one spelling: a hooded cloak and a head of land.
intro.cn: cape 的两个拉丁来源落到同一个拼法上：带兜帽的外衣，与陆地之头。

items.en: Caput means head.
items.cn: caput 意为头。

items.en: Capputium means a hooded cloak.
items.cn: capputium 意为带兜帽的斗篷。

items.en: Cape means both a cloak and a headland.
items.cn: cape 兼指斗篷与岬角。

items.en: English cape carries both senses.
items.cn: 十四世纪英语已兼指两义。

items.en: Sailors mark headlands as capes.
items.cn: 十六世纪海图把岬角标为 cape。

items.en: Cape stays a cloak and a point of land.
items.cn: 现代仍指斗篷与海角。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the short cap- shape; the near-meaning group splits into cloaks on one side and sea points on the other.
note.cn: 形近组共享短小的 cap- 形；近义组一边是斗篷，一边是海岬。

entries.definition: A soft hat with a peak.
More than one cape.
A short cape covering the shoulders.
A loose outer garment without sleeves.
A cloth worn over the shoulders.
High land projecting into the sea.
Land almost surrounded by water.

normalIntro.en: A cape hangs from the shoulders, and a cape sticks out like a shoulder of land.
normalIntro.cn: 披在肩上的是斗篷，像肩膀一样探出去的是海角。

normal.en: Caput means head in Latin.
normal.cn: caput 在拉丁语里是头。

normal.en: A head of land is a cape.
normal.cn: 陆地的「头」就是海角。

normal.en: Capputium was a hooded cloak.
normal.cn: capputium 是带兜帽的外衣。

normal.en: Both became cape in English.
normal.cn: 两者在英语里都成了 cape。

normal.en: One for the shoulders, one for the sea.
normal.cn: 一个披肩，一个伸进海里。

abstract.en: Cloth that falls from the shoulders.
abstract.cn: 从肩上下垂的布。

abstract.en: Rock that falls into the sea.
abstract.cn: 伸进海里的岩石。

abstract.en: Two kinds of edge, one short word.
abstract.cn: 两种边缘，一个短词。

examples.en: She wrapped a woollen cape around her shoulders.
examples.cn: 她把羊毛斗篷裹在肩上。

examples.en: Storms are common off the cape in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天海角外常有风暴。

examples.en: The lighthouse stands at the tip of the cape.
examples.cn: 灯塔立在海角的最末端。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开披」——一开披，斗篷就展开了。

root: 拉丁 caput（头）/ capputium（带兜帽外衣）→ 海角；斗篷

sensesIntro.en: Both senses are about something hanging or projecting from a body: cloth from shoulders, rock from a coast.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都关乎从主体探出的东西：布从肩头垂下，岩石从海岸伸出。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloak pulled tight against wind at the edge of the sea
core.cn: 核心意象：海边风口处被拉紧的斗篷

branches.en: A black cloak on a stage.
branches.cn: 舞台上的一件黑斗篷。

branches.en: Fur across the shoulders.
branches.cn: 搭在肩上的毛皮。

branches.en: A lighthouse at the tip.
branches.cn: 海角末端的灯塔。

branches.en: A ship rounding the point.
branches.cn: 绕过海角的船。

branches.en: Two edges of the same body.
branches.cn: 同一主体的两种边缘。

intro.en: Cape carries the Latin word for head; the list below covers that root and the vocabulary of headlands and cloaks.
intro.cn: cape 带着拉丁语「头」的词根；下面列出该词根以及「岬角、斗篷」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin caput is head, pallium is a cloak, and paene insula means almost an island.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 caput 意为头，pallium 意为斗篷，paene insula 意为几乎是岛。

peninsula 产生 peninsula。

definition_zh: 首都；资本；大写字母
definition_en: the most important city of a country, or money used to start and grow a business
core_image: 一切从这里出发的那个「头」
scene: 他坐火车去首都找工作。He took a train to the capital to look for work.
sceneCN: 这里 capital 是「首都」（第 1 个义项：一国的政治中心）；句意是他坐火车去首都找工作。

derivatives.zh: capital 加 -ize 构成，义为「利用；资本化；大写」
capital 加 -ism 构成，义为「资本主义」
capital 加 -ist 构成，义为「资本家」

senses.title: The chief city of a country
senses.definition: the city where a country or region has its government
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家或地区政府所在地的城市
senses.example: The capital is crowded with tourists in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 夏天首都挤满了游客。
senses.why: Latin caput means head, so the chief city is the head of the body politic.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 caput 意为「头」，一国的首城自然就是政治身体的「头」。

senses.title: Money used to start or grow a business
senses.definition: money and property used to produce more wealth
senses.definitionCN: 用来产生更多财富的金钱和资产
senses.example: The startup needs more capital to expand.
senses.exampleCN: 这家初创公司需要更多资本来扩张。
senses.why: The head of a sum of money is its main stock, and that stock came to be called capital.
senses.whyCN: 一笔钱的「头」就是它的本金，这份本金后来就被称为 capital。

senses.title: A large letter at the start of a word
senses.definition: the large form of a letter, used at the beginning of names and sentences
senses.definitionCN: 字母的大写形式，用于名字和句子的开头
senses.example: Write your name in capital letters.
senses.exampleCN: 请用大写字母写你的名字。
senses.why: The head letter of a word is written large, so capital came to mean uppercase.
senses.whyCN: 一个词的「头一个字母」写得更大，于是 capital 又有了「大写」的意思。

intro.en: Capital descends from the Latin word for head, and each sense grows from that image of the head.
intro.cn: capital 源自拉丁语中表示「头」的词，每个义项都从「头」这个意象长出来。

items.en: caput meant head, the top of the body and by extension the top of anything.
items.cn: caput 意为「头」，既是身体顶端，也引申为任何事物的顶端。

items.en: capitalis meant of the head or chief, and named what stood first in importance.
items.cn: capitalis 意为「与头有关的、首要的」，指在重要性上排在首位的东西。

items.en: Old French capital carried the senses of chief and of the main sum of money.
items.cn: 古法语 capital 同时带有「首要」与「本金」两重意思。

items.en: English used capital for the chief city and for the head letter of a word.
items.cn: 中古英语用 capital 指首要城市，也指单词的头一个字母。

items.en: The financial sense grew with trade, and capital now means the money behind a business.
items.cn: 随着贸易发展，金融义壮大，今天 capital 指企业背后的本钱。

note.en: Capital shares the Latin head root with captain and chief, and it is easily confused with capitol.
note.cn: capital 与 captain、chief 共享拉丁语「头」这个词根，又容易与 capitol 混淆。

entries.definition: the building where a legislature meets, especially in the United States
entries.definitionCN: 议会大厦，尤指美国国会大厦；与 capital 读音相同，只是拼写相近，来源不同。

entries.definition: an economic system based on private ownership and profit
entries.definitionCN: 以私有制和利润为基础的经济制度，由 capital 加 -ism 构成。

entries.definition: to write with a capital letter, or to turn something into capital
entries.definitionCN: 写成大写，或使资本化，由 capital 加 -ize 构成。

entries.definition: a very large and important city
entries.definitionCN: 大都市，与「首都」同属重要城市的概念。

entries.definition: a sum of money kept for a particular purpose
entries.definitionCN: 为特定目的保存的一笔钱，对应「资本」义。

entries.definition: written in large letters
entries.definitionCN: 大写字母的，正好对应第三个义项。

normalIntro.en: One Latin word for head explains all three senses: the head city, the head sum, the head letter.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁语的「头」一词解释了全部三个义项：头的城市、头的本金、头的字母。

normal.en: cap- comes from Latin caput, head, the same root as captain and chief.
normal.cn: cap- 来自拉丁语 caput（头），与 captain、chief 同根。

normal.en: The capital city is the head of the country.
normal.cn: 首都就是国家的「头」。

normal.en: Capital as money is the head, or main stock, of a business.
normal.cn: 作为钱的 capital 是企业的「头」，也就是本金。

normal.en: A capital letter is the large head letter of a word.
normal.cn: 大写字母就是一个词的「头字母」，写得更大。

normal.en: capitalize covers both of the smaller senses: to uppercase and to turn into capital.
normal.cn: capitalize 覆盖了两个较小的义项：写成大写，以及使资本化。

abstract.en: Picture a body whose head decides where the whole body walks.
abstract.cn: 想象一个身体，头决定整个身体往哪走。

abstract.en: Picture a pile of coins with one big coin sitting on top like a head.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆硬币，最上面压着一枚大硬币，像一颗头。

abstract.en: Picture the first letter of a name standing taller than all the rest.
abstract.cn: 想象名字的第一个字母比其余字母都高出一截。

examples.en: He took a train to the capital to look for work.
examples.cn: 他坐火车去首都找工作。

examples.en: The startup needs more capital to expand.
examples.cn: 这家初创公司需要更多资本来扩张。

examples.en: Write your name in capital letters.
examples.cn: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开批头」——开头那个字母要写大，那就是 capital。

root: 拉丁语 caput（头）→ capitalis（与头有关的、首要的）→ 古法语 capital → 英语 capital；同根词有 captain、chief、chapter。

sensesIntro.en: Head as place, head as money, head as letter: three extensions of one bodily image.
sensesIntro.cn: 头作为地方、头作为钱、头作为字母：同一个身体意象的三次延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the head, the part that stands at the top and leads the rest.
core.cn: 核心意象：头，位于顶端并带领其余部分的那一块。

branches.en: The political head: the city where the government sits.
branches.cn: 政治上的头：政府所在的城市。

branches.en: The financial head: the main sum that a business builds on.
branches.cn: 财务上的头：企业赖以发展的本金。

branches.en: The written head: the first letter of a word, set larger.
branches.cn: 书写上的头：单词的第一个字母，写得更大。

branches.en: All three senses keep the meaning chief or first in their own field.
branches.cn: 三个义项都保留着「各自领域里居首」的意思。

branches.en: capitalism and capitalist extend the money sense into a whole system.
branches.cn: capitalism 与 capitalist 把金钱义扩展成一整套制度。

intro.en: Capital is built on the root capit-, head, with the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: capital 建立在词根 capit-（头）之上，加上形容词词尾 -al。

latinIntro.en: Latin caput and capitalis supply the head root for a whole family of English words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 caput 与 capitalis 为整整一个英语词族提供了「头」这个词根。

items.meaning: chief, or the main city, money, or letter

items.example: Several capitals lie on the same river.

items.meaning: a person who owns or invests capital

items.example: Caput is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: caput 是整个词族的源头。

items.example: Capitalis gave French and English capital.
items.exampleCN: capitalis 演变为法语和英语的 capital。

items.meaning: a main division of a book

definition_zh: v. （船等）倾覆，翻覆；使（船）倾覆
definition_en: to overturn in the water, or to make a boat overturn
core_image: 小船一侧进水，几秒钟内底朝天
scene: 小船一侧进了水，几秒钟就翻了个底朝天。The small boat took water on one side and capsized within seconds.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：capsize 指船只倾覆；句意是小船一侧进水，几秒内就翻了。

senses.title: For a boat to overturn
senses.definition: of a boat, to turn over in the water so that it floats upside down
senses.definitionCN: 船只在水里翻过来，底朝天漂浮
senses.example: The dinghy capsized a hundred metres from shore.
senses.exampleCN: 小艇在离岸一百米处翻了。
senses.why: The word probably comes from a Spanish verb meaning to sink by the head.
senses.whyCN: 这个词大概来自西班牙语动词，意为「头朝下沉」。

senses.title: To make a boat overturn
senses.definition: to cause a boat to overturn, usually by moving weight badly

definition_zh: n. 胶囊；太空舱，密封舱；小容器；蒴果
definition_en: a small soluble shell holding medicine; a sealed compartment, as of a spacecraft; a seed case
core_image: 掌心滚动的一粒小胶囊，壳上印着半个字母
scene: 一粒胶囊在掌心滚动，壳上印着半个字母。A capsule rolled in his palm with half a letter printed on the shell.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：capsule 指胶囊；句意是它在掌心滚动，壳上只印着半个字母。

senses.title: A shell for medicine
senses.definition: a small tube of gelatine that holds a dose of medicine and dissolves in the stomach
senses.definitionCN: 装一剂药、在胃里溶开的小明胶壳
senses.example: Take one capsule with water after meals.
senses.exampleCN: 饭后用水服一粒胶囊。
senses.why: Latin capsula means a small box, and the shell is a tiny box for the powder.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 capsula 意为小盒子，胶囊就是装药粉的小盒子。

senses.title: A sealed compartment
senses.definition: a closed container or module that protects what is inside, as in a spacecraft
senses.definitionCN: 保护内部物体的密闭容器或舱体，如航天器
senses.example: The capsule returned to Earth after six months.
senses.exampleCN: 太空舱在六个月后返回地球。
senses.why: The box image scales up to a cabin built to survive vacuum and heat.
senses.whyCN: 「盒子」的形象放大成能耐受真空与高温的舱体。

intro.en: Capsule comes from Latin capsula, a small box, from capsa, a case.

sensesIntro.cn: 药丸与航天舱都是密封的盒子，用来保护所载之物。

definition_zh: n. （图片的）说明文字，图注；（影视）字幕；v. 给……加说明文字
definition_en: the words printed under a picture explaining it; words shown on a screen; to add such words
core_image: 照片下方那行不显眼的小字
scene: 照片下面那行小字把年份写错了。The caption under the photograph gave the wrong year.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：caption 指图片说明文字；句意是照片下方的小字把年份写错了。

senses.title: Words under a picture
senses.definition: a short line printed below a picture to explain or identify it
senses.definitionCN: 印在图片下方用于解释或说明的短句
senses.example: Each photograph had a caption naming the village.
senses.exampleCN: 每张照片都有一行注明村名的说明。
senses.why: Latin captio means a taking, and a caption takes hold of what the image shows.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 captio 意为「抓取」，说明文字抓住图像所示之物。

senses.title: Words on a screen
senses.definition: the text shown at the bottom of a screen for dialogue or description

senses.example: Turn on the captions for the film.
senses.exampleCN: 给这部电影开字幕。
senses.why: Broadcasting borrowed the print layout and put it on a screen.
senses.whyCN: 广播把印刷版面搬到屏幕上。

intro.en: Caption comes from Latin captio, a taking, from capere, to seize.
intro.cn: caption 源自拉丁语 captio（抓取），词根是 capere（拿取）。

items.en: Capere means to seize.

items.en: Caption settles on text under a picture.
items.cn: 十九世纪固定为图片下方的文字。

items.en: Captions appear on television screens.
items.cn: 二十世纪字幕出现在电视屏幕上。

definition_zh: v. 使着迷，吸引住；使倾心
definition_en: to hold someone attention completely; to win someone affection strongly
core_image: 木偶一举手，孩子的眼睛就再没离开过
scene: 木偶戏让孩子一动不动，连糖都忘了吃。The puppet show captivated the child for a full hour.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：captivate 指完全吸引住注意力；句意是木偶戏让孩子一动不动看了整整一小时。

senses.title: To hold attention completely
senses.definition: to take and keep all of someone attention, so that nothing else matters
senses.definitionCN: 占据并保持某人全部注意力，使别的事情都不重要
senses.example: The lecture captivated the whole room.
senses.exampleCN: 那场讲座让全场入迷。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to take captive, and attention can be taken the same way.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词原意为「使成俘虏」，注意力也可以这样被夺走。

senses.title: To win affection
senses.definition: to attract someone so strongly that they feel drawn to you
senses.definitionCN: 强烈吸引某人，使其心向你
senses.example: Her honesty captivated him long before her wit.
senses.exampleCN: 早在她展现机智之前，她的坦诚就让他倾心。
senses.why: The word moves from holding the mind to holding the heart.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从占据头脑转向占据人心。

normal.en: Attention is what gets captured.

definition_zh: adj. 被俘的，被关押的；受制于某处的；n. 俘虏，被关押者
definition_en: kept as a prisoner or held in a place and unable to leave; a person or animal held this way
core_image: 笼中不再撞栏杆、只盯着门外的鸟

senses.title: Held as a prisoner
senses.definition: kept in a place and not allowed to leave, as a prisoner or a caged animal
senses.definitionCN: 被关在某处不许离开，如俘虏或笼中动物
senses.example: The captive soldiers were marched inland.

senses.why: From Latin captivus, taken from capere, to seize.

senses.whyCN: 商业与社会用法把「笼子」扩展到任何走不开的地方。
